# the contributor audit: affine weights, atomic alternatives, and physical properness

This records proved scope and dependencies. It is not a proof of OC.

## Independently checked sources

1. `candidate 3101206ec4580190`:
   positive affine factors preserve concavity and continuous projective
   alignment; arithmetic normalization may have a boundary infimum.
2. `candidate 9ae432ab1b731d70`:
   root full read PASS; witness midpoint parity is disjoint from the actual
   surviving closed face trace. No false count of all outside parities is
   used. Closed caps retain all their atoms.
3. `candidate 108870e8f9aac2e9`:
   full independent Defect audit PASS, including all normalization and
   penalty derivatives. the contributor reran the independent verifier: 2,606 exact
   symbolic/rational checks PASS.
4. `candidate 5f79e6103cd27dac`:
   root full read PASS through Section 5; independent Two-sided audit PASS.
   Whole-fiber capture uses strict missed points and actual Minkowski
   compatibility. The compact active-menu gap proves own properness;
   supporting facets in other fibers still use nonlinear inverse losses.
   Exposed-vertex contraction is an unpenalized descent only.
5. `candidate 28887b22d8a60544`:
   root full read PASS. Actual midpoint-square inclusion, covariance,
   all-direction estimates, monotone minimax crossing, and escape exponents
   check. the contributor reran 2,063 exact checks PASS. The actual middle-source unit
   shifts are >=41/3600; the body lies strictly above OC. The example does
   not refute the below-target joint body minimum.
6. `candidate 7c213e6353a4073e`:
   root full read PASS through Section 6, consistent with Defect's audit.
   Full independent signed convex-field freedom is explicit. Martingale
   transport stays on each actual supporting facet; curved/extreme planar
   boundary receives zero density. Finite facets and analytic arcs follow
   only under this freedom premise. The critical disk is a valid obstruction
   to unconditional polygonality, not a bad extremal body.

## Dependency graph for the currently valid variational interface

Original hypothetical bad family
  -> cardinality-minimal bad canonical complete base
  -> original bad-sublevel compactness and positive fiber lower bounds
  -> proper closed-minor mass quotas.

These inputs feed TWO distinct valid constructions:

* Quotas -> complement-face atomic center -> geometric-normalized affine
  parameter cannot escape a fixed-epsilon bad sublevel -> attained
  UNPENALIZED positive joint minimum. Properness still needs the strict
  atomic gap or an additional argument.
* Original compact family + ell=1 comparison -> attained PENALIZED positive
  joint minimum -> arithmetic mean P=O(1/epsilon) -> physical buffer tends
  uniformly to zero -> all maximizing own cuts proper.

Proper own cuts + exact old-contact covers
  -> finite critical groups and parity-face cover
  -> exact supporting-cap directional inverses
  -> scoped regular linear response when full cap regularity is proved.

The penalized regular singleton branch additionally has the exact affine-
parameter moment identity (16) in the root source. It has not yet produced
the desired Gamma_d/k bound. All new body, mass, covariance, geometric-
normalization and penalty derivatives must enter one common dual.

## Boundary conditions that must not be silently removed

* Fixed-epsilon parameter compactness does not imply uniformly small
  physical buffers as epsilon tends to zero.
* Strict minor quotas alone do not force ordinary deepest bases away from
  a proper exposed face; the square/triangle/small-square example disproves
  this already in positive planar fibers.
* A pure-base plateau need not have any proper active cut. The strict-gap
  branch is a real alternative, not a removable technical distinction.
* Small absolute penalty does not imply a small relative stationarity term.
* Regular singleton moment equations do not cover arbitrary contact faces
  or supporting-facet branches without their own exact continuation.
* Free-fiber or free-facet variation cannot be inferred from an algebraic
  dual density when mixed Minkowski contacts are tight.

The general sharp mass payment, or an alternative complete closing
argument, remains unproved. No completion is claimed.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
